definition: Where a bar closed inside its range, from -1 at the low to 1 at the high: ((close - low) - (high - close)) / (high - low), the money flow multiplier of the Accumulation Distribution Line.
boundaries: An estimate of who pressed, read from the bar alone: it is the last step of every order-flow entry's fallback chain, never traded buying or selling. A bar whose high equals its low reads 0, as TA-Lib's AD counts it. It needs only the bar's prices, so it reads on every bar a unit is given.
recognition: Closes near the high bar after bar read as buyers pressing.

sources.quote: Money Flow Multiplier = [(Close - Low) - (High - Close)] /(High - Low)
classified broker Bid/Ask quote updates to estimate Up/Down Tick pressure

golden.reference: TA-Lib 0.7.1 AD over a volume of 1, first difference, in qml/tests/golden/beyond-fx/reference_run.py
